declaration.title: Cloud Function literal environment contains a likely secret
declaration.remediation: Move literal credentials to Secret Manager references and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the function’s literal environment values.
The value is hidden; detection did not validate the credential.

opt_in.activation: literal boolean true only; root owns connector/selection admission

transport_order: Successful unmasked native Functions v2 JSON response
Opt-in bounded raw value detection for serviceConfig and buildConfig separately
Drop raw values via existing sanitize function
Existing functions hydration and envelope sanitization
Pure predicate plus existing one-finding-per-value deduplication

integration.engine_reason: peaso.engine already calls deduplicate_secret_findings, keyed by provider and process-HMAC value fingerprint.
integration.names_preservation: Second proposed hunk prevents env_names from adding an empty environmentVariables map when environmentVariableNames already exists, which otherwise erases actual names during later sanitize.

identity: Exact HTTPS cloudfunctions.googleapis.com v2 list/get, matching requested project and explicit location/name; list wildcard location accepts valid native locations within that project; field-masked reads, unsupported bodies and foreign identities cannot produce a clean scan.

detectors.kingfisher: 1.4.0 SDK detection-only ScanInput; Rules(cache=False); no Validator or Revoker
detectors.network_or_credential_validation: never requested; scanner adapters operate offline; no Secret Manager payload reads
detectors.deduplication: Existing process-random HMAC fingerprints plus merge_leaks merge exact matched values across both engines and both surfaces; no raw or reversible value hash is serialized.

semantics.fail: Complete scans detect at least one supported likely-secret value; credential validity is never asserted.
semantics.pass: Both maps are complete and both pinned detectors complete on both; absence means no supported detector match in these returned maps only.
semantics.unknown: Default-off, denied/incomplete/foreign/malformed/bounded/cancelled/time-exhausted reads or any incomplete detector; partial positive redacted indicators remain available but do not yield a complete verdict.
semantics.excluded: Secret Manager payloads, function source archives, logs, runtime memory, historical revisions, third-party endpoints and effective credential permissions.

privacy: Only names, native configuration metadata, engine/version/status, bounded byte/pair counts, process-HMAC fingerprints and constant surface/line locations survive; no raw values, snippets, engine stderr or exception text enter marker/cache/evidence.
